name: @muen/dsh-brand-swap
description: White-label brand swap for DeepSeek Harness — replaces the DeepSeek mark in the sidebar and hero with a per-profile wordmark (row config) or uploaded transparent PNG logos for light and dark themes via a Settings → Brand page, and (with the hero tagline seam) the blank-session hero headline. Neutral defaults; every Brand OS configures its own identity.
